title: Rory and the Sleeping Lagoon
verses:
The sun was descending behind the blue sea,
The water was humming so slow,
And Rory stepped softly beside a tall tree,
To watch the pale lavender glow.

High over the ripples did Nia glide down,
She folded her wings on the sand,
While Ricky curled up in the moss that was brown,
Across the calm curve of the land.

Then Benny lay heavy and sighed in the breeze,
His long neck relaxed in the deep,
While Tilly walked over between the still trees,
Where shadows were falling asleep.

Now Psittaco chirped from a pillow of grass,
A lullaby gentle and light,
While over the water the quiet winds pass,
To welcome the hush of the night.

When Rory lay down in the center to rest,
The stars began blinking above,
His friends gathered close in a slumbering nest,
Wrapped up in the warmest of love.

The water was still as the moon rose on high,
The tide whispered soft to the shore,
While sleepy clouds drifted across the dark sky,
And dinosaurs dreamed evermore.
